items.question: Which piece of evidence BEST supports the Big Bang theory's explanation for the formation of light elements?
options: The observed abundance of hydrogen and helium in the universe
The presence of heavy elements in the Earth's crust
The discovery of exoplanets around distant stars
The formation of black holes in the centers of galaxies

items.question: What does the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation represent?
options: The light from the first stars
The leftover heat from the Big Bang

items.question: Which process is primarily responsible for the formation of heavier elements like carbon and oxygen during stellar evolution?
Which of the following is a correct nuclear fusion reaction that takes place in stars?
Why are elements heavier than iron formed ONLY in extreme events like supernovae?
options: Iron is the heaviest element that exists
Fusion beyond iron absorbs energy instead of releasing it
Iron cannot undergo any nuclear reactions
Heavier elements are unstable in stars

items.question: The r-process (rapid neutron capture) that forms elements heavier than iron occurs mainly during:
options: The main sequence phase of a star
Supernova explosions and neutron star mergers

items.question: Which Ancient Greek philosopher first proposed that all matter is made of tiny, indivisible particles called 'atomos'?
Aristotle rejected Democritus' atomic theory because he believed that:
options: Atoms were too small to see
Matter was continuous and made of four elements
Atoms moved too slowly to be observed

items.question: Which of the following was NOT one of the four classical Greek elements?
According to Ancient Greek cosmology, what was the fifth element that filled the heavens?
Which type of motion did the Ancient Greeks consider 'violent'?
options: The natural fall of a stone to the ground
The circular orbit of the Moon
The forced motion of an object pushed by a hand

items.question: According to Aristotle, natural motion of an object:
options: Continues only while a force acts on it
Depends on the object's tendency to return to its natural place

items.question: Which observation led Ancient Greeks to conclude that the Earth is spherical?
options: The rising and setting of the Sun
The circular shadow of the Earth on the Moon during a lunar eclipse
The movement of clouds in the sky

items.question: Eratosthenes estimated the circumference of the Earth by comparing:
options: The angles of shadows in two cities at noon
The positions of stars at midnight
The speed of ships at sea
